title: Opportunity data ingestion and review
objective: Provide a controlled path for adding source-linked opportunity records without crawling or auto-publishing unreviewed content.
guardrails: Preview blocks invalid HTTPS URLs, duplicate IDs, invalid date/age ranges. Unknown hosts receive a review warning
nothing publishes without an explicit reviewer decision.
exitCriteria: A contributor submits one JSON record
reviewers can inspect findings, approve or reject. Rejected/pending records never appear in public search.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
